links.comparator_used: Static model developed on 2009-mid-2015 visits and applied unchanged to late 2015-2019 visits, compared with new models retrained for each calendar year 2015-2019
links.outcome: Classification performance (AUC), sensitivity, positive predictive value and calibration for predicting self-harm within 90 days; predictors selected
links.effect: Static model AUC 0.840-0.849 in the new sample versus 0.851 in the original sample; new yearly models AUC range 0.790-0.853, with sensitivity and PPV similar to the previously developed model
links.quote: New models did not yield superior performance or identify different predictors.

design_hint: drift monitoring / temporal revalidation of prediction model
